headlines.title: Días muy calurosos y noches más frescas, así se sentirá el clima esta semana en Nicaragua
Exclusion of Exiled Bishops Shakes the Nicaraguan Episcopal Conference
Os cidadãos impedidos pelo governo Ortega de voltar à Nicarágua: 'Sou ilegal no meu próprio país'
Dictadura Ortega-Murillo convirtió retroactividad jurídica en el instrumento clave de su régimen de facto en Nicaragua
Maradiaga desafía a Ortega y Murillo: exige permitir el regreso de opositores para hacer política dentro de Nicaragua

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The Ortega-Murillo regime has made legal retroactivity a key instrument of its de facto rule in Nicaragua. [4]
Exiled bishops have been excluded from the Nicaraguan Episcopal Conference, causing upheaval. [2]

KEY RISKS
The most severe government travel advisory World Monitor tracks for Nicaragua is Reconsider Travel, as of Nov 24, 2026, indicating elevated risk for foreign engagement. [E1]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether Maradiaga's demand that Ortega and Murillo allow the return of opponents for political activity will be heeded. [5]
Whether citizens prevented by the Ortega government from returning to Nicaragua will be allowed re-entry. [3]
